webpack is part of 11 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (4), [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (3), [Web](@/projects/web.md) (3) and [Libraries](@/projects/libraries.md) (1).

Most recently: [czech-stats](@/work/czech-stats.md); [microcrawler-browser](@/work/microcrawler-browser.md): Proof-of-Concept: Microcrawler in your Browser!; [kanec](@/work/kanec.md).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses webpack: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links webpack to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
